classes.removal_criterion: folder specs stay readable; new specs are flat by default
undated folders convert to a dated flat file when every reference resolves to the new path; zero remaining in consumers' dry-runs

blocked converts to in-progress plus an operational wait (action request or external wait); removable when no consumer dry-run reports a blocked spec and the adoption metrics v2 have shipped for one minor
each legacy key moves into contract_adoptions with the same date, so the cutoff keeps its meaning; removable after one minor in which doctor reports review.adoption-source for every consumer
an unknown key must not silence an expected enforcement: a major refuses it until it is renamed or removed
never removed: a sealed bundle is the subject of a signed or recorded judgment
read under the contracts their seal date implies; never re-sealed
declared identity stays disclosed as declared; a major may require verified identity for new attestations only
rendered as legacy-undifferentiated; supplements may clarify roles without altering the signed record
a major's migration refuses to run while a transfer is incomplete; resume or roll it back first

limitations: a dry-run: nothing is written, and no apply exists in 6.x
counts describe this repository only; consumers' corpora must run their own dry-run before a removal is decided
